description: This file contains FastAPI route definitions for event management, including creating, listing, retrieving, scoring, and recommending events with weather data integration. It also includes stub email notifications and external API interactions.

classes.name: EventResponse
classes.description: Schema representing event data returned via API

classes.name: RecommendationResponse
classes.description: Schema for recommendation results, including options and metadata

classes.name: ScoreResponse
classes.description: Schema for scoring results, including options and notes

classes.name: ScoredOption
classes.description: Individual recommended option with label and score

classes.name: ScoreRequest
classes.description: Payload schema for scoring a date with location and forecast parameters

classes.name: RecommendationRequest
classes.description: Payload schema for generating recommendations for a new event

methods.name: EventResponse create_event(payload: EventRequest, repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo))
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new event and store it in the in-memory repository.

methods.name: List[EventResponse] list_events( userId: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Filter events by associated user ID"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: API endpoint to list all events, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: EventResponse get_event( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve a specific event by ID.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse get_recommendations( event_id: str = Path(..., description="Event identifier"), repo: InMemoryEventsRepository = Depends(get_events_repo), )
methods.description: API endpoint to generate placeholder recommendations for an event.

methods.name: ScoreResponse score_event_date(payload: ScoreRequest)
methods.description: Asynchronous API endpoint to score weather suitability over time windows for a given date and location.

methods.name: RecommendationResponse post_recommendations(payload: RecommendationRequest)
methods.description: API endpoint to generate weather-aware recommendations for a new ad-hoc event.
